Date June 11, 1940.
Subject Royal Italian Embassy - wireless receiving sets consigned to,
Made by D. S. I. Hide Forwarded by D. I. Crawford
Information has been received to the effect
that two cases containing a radio receiving set
consigned to Dr. P. Prunas of the Royal Italian
Embassy arrived from New York by the s.s. Yomachichi
on or about May 22nd 1940. The gross weight of
the cases was 78 kilos. and the net weight 37 kilos.
Two other cases also said to contain a radio
receiving set consigned to Dr. C. Laurenti, Chancellor
of the Royal Italian Embassy, arrived from New York
by the same vessel.
All cases were exempted from Customs duty.
D. S. I.
D.C. (Special Branch)

SUBJECT: Reference Memorandum on alleged
proposed sale of s.s. "CONTE VERDE".

CONFIDENTIAL

Since the beginning of the war there have
been four German ships tied up at Yokohama, eight at
Kobe and six at Dairen, besides the "Ramses" here.
At least three of these German vessels would make
better Raiders than the "Conte Verde" but, as far as
is known, nothing has been done to prepare any of
them for raiding; either the Japanese would not let
them or the Germans have not thought it worth while.

There have been numerous reports also of
Japanese intention to purchase or charter German
ships for operation in the Inland Sea and territorial
waters; after eight months warfare, however, no
purchases or charters have been effected.

A. Neville
Lieutenant Colonel.
Royal Marines.

CONFIDENTIAL

主题：关于据称拟出售“CONTE VERDE”号轮船的参考备忘录。

机密

自战争爆发以来，除停泊在此处的“Ramses”号外，
还有四艘德国船只停泊在横滨，八艘停泊在神户，
六艘停泊在大连。
这些德国船只中，至少有三艘比“Conte Verde”号
更适合改装为袭击舰，但据所知，并未采取任何措施
将它们准备用于袭击任务；要么是日本人不予放行，
要么是德国人认为不值得这样做。

此外，还有许多关于日本意图购买或租用德国船只
以在内海和领海内运营的报道；然而，经过八个月的战争，
尚未达成任何购买或租赁交易。

A. Neville
中校。
皇家海军陆战队。

机密

PROPOSED SALE OF THE S.S. "CONTE VERDE" TO THE
JAPANESE SHIPPING COMPANY.

Information has been received from a very
reliable source to the effect that upon instructions from
its Head Office in Tokyo the local branch of the Toa Kaiun
Kaisha, Japanese Shipping Company, 5 the Bund, has begun
negotiations with the local branch of the Lloyd Triestino
with a view to purchasing the s.s. "Conte Verde" now laying
in Shanghai. No definite reply has as yet been given by
the Lloyd Triestino as they are awaiting a cable from the
Head Office in Rome. It has been learned that the Lloyd
Triestino doubt very much that this offer will meet support
of the Italian Government as they are of the opinion that the
s.s. "Conte Verde", a very fast ship, will in the near future
depart for Kobe, Japan, where it would be converted into an
Auxiliary Cruiser for the purpose of raiding Allied Shipping
in the Pacific Ocean.

The Lloyd Triestino has, however, offered the
Toa Kaiun Kaisha the opportunity of purchasing for
U.S.$2,260,000.00 a newly constructed passenger-freighter
which recently arrived in Japan on its maiden voyage.

Dr Piero Terni, Italian lawyer of 149 Yuen Ming
Yuen Road is acting as a go-between and preliminary
negotiations were started at his Office.
pages.zh:
副本。

拟将“CONTE VERDE”号轮船出售给
日本航运公司。

据非常可靠的消息来源称，东亚海运株式会社
（Toa Kaiun Kaisha，日本航运公司）上海分公司
（地址：外滩5号）已根据其在东京总公司的指示，
开始与意大利邮船公司（Lloyd Triestino）上海分公司
进行谈判，旨在购买目前停泊在上海的“Conte Verde”号轮船。
意大利邮船公司尚未给予明确答复，因为他们正在等待
罗马总公司的电报。据悉，意大利邮船公司非常怀疑
这一提议是否会得到意大利政府的支持，因为他们认为，
“Conte Verde”号是一艘速度很快的船只，将在不久的将来
启程前往日本神户，在那里它将被改装为辅助巡洋舰，
用于在太平洋上袭击盟国航运。

然而，意大利邮船公司已向东亚海运株式会社提供机会，
以2,260,000.00美元的价格购买一艘新建造的客货轮，
该船最近在日本完成了首航并抵达。

皮耶罗·泰尔尼（Piero Terni）博士，意大利律师，
住址：圆明园路149号，正担任中间人，初步谈判
在其办公室开始。

pages.zh:
拟将“CONTE VERDE”号轮船出售给日本
航运公司。

据非常可靠的消息来源称，东亚海运株式会社
（Toa Kaiun Kaisha，日本航运公司）上海分公司
（地址：外滩5号）已根据其在东京总公司的指示，
开始与意大利邮船公司（Lloyd Triestino）上海分公司
进行谈判，旨在购买目前停泊在上海的“Conte
Verde”号轮船。意大利邮船公司尚未给予明确答复，
因为他们正在等待罗马总公司的电报。
据悉，意大利邮船公司非常怀疑这一提议是否会得到
意大利政府的支持，因为他们认为，“Conte
Verde”号是一艘速度很快的船只，将在不久的将来
启程前往日本神户，在那里它将被改装为辅助巡洋舰，
用于在太平洋上袭击盟国航运。
然而，意大利邮船公司已向东亚海运株式会社提供机会，
以2,860,000.00美元的价格购买一艘新建造的客货轮，
该船最近在日本完成了首航并抵达。
皮耶罗·托尔尼（Piero Torni）博士，意大利律师，
住址：圆明园路149号，正担任中间人，初步谈判
在其办公室开始。
